scams.name: Florianópolis Hercílio Luz Airport (FLN) Taxi Mafia & Beach Transfer Overcharge
scams.description: Florianópolis's Hercílio Luz Airport (FLN, 12 km from Centro) is South Brazil's main coastal arrival point and hosts a 2025 taxi-overcharge ecosystem common to Brazilian airports. Community reports document Florianópolis tourist logistics across 2024-2026. The 2025 scams: (a) FLN arrivals-kerb 'Special Taxi' kiosks quoting R$ 150–R$ 300 to Centro / Lagoa da Conceição / Jurerê (real Uber R$ 50–R$ 120 depending on destination); (b) sign-holders posing as 'pousada transfer' agents intercepting tourists; (c) Uber driver cancel-and-recontract scam — same template as São Paulo / Rio; (d) 'beach circuit transfer R$ 400' bundle marked up vs DIY local-bus access; (e) 'meter broken' yellow taxi demands at hotel arrival with R$ 200+ flat-rate cash demand; (f) GIG-to-FLN airline-misdirection touts at GRU / GIG offering 'cheap flight package' to Floripa that turn out to be expired credits or Bolivian-airline fraud; (g) 'private driver to praia + lunch combo R$ 400' commission bundles (real Uber to Praia Mole R$ 30–R$ 60). For travellers: (1) book Uber / 99 on airport Wi-Fi AFTER luggage — typical FLN to Centro R$ 50–R$ 80 (15 min); to Lagoa da Conceição R$ 70–R$ 100 (25 min); to Praia Mole R$ 80–R$ 120 (35 min); to Jurerê (north island) R$ 100–R$ 150 (40 min); (2) at FLN, meet driver at the designated 'Aplicativos' pickup zone signposted at terminal exit; (3) IGNORE every 'Special Taxi' kiosk inside terminal quoting above R$ 150 to Centro; (4) the LOCAL BUS Florianópolis (Consórcio Fênix) connects FLN to TICEN central terminal at R$ 5.50 per person (40 min) — budget alternative; (5) for return to FLN, pre-book Uber the night before; (6) NEVER hand a credit card to any taxi driver — pay in-app or cash only; (7) for the beach circuit (Mole / Joaquina / Galheta / Barra da Lagoa), local bus is R$ 5.50 each beach OR Uber R$ 30–R$ 60 between beaches; (8) DEATUR Florianópolis +55 48 3271 6390 (English available, R. Carlos Adolfo Wendhausen, 86).
scams.avoidance: Book Uber/99 on airport Wi-Fi: FLN-Centro R$ 50–R$ 80; Lagoa R$ 70–R$ 100 Meet driver at 'Aplicativos' signposted pickup zone OR Consórcio Fênix local bus FLN-TICEN R$ 5.50 (40 min) NEVER hand credit card to any taxi driver DEATUR +55 48 3271 6390 (English available)
scams.location: Hercílio Luz International Airport (FLN) arrivals, Centro / Lagoa da Conceição / Praia Mole / Jurerê transfer routes, FLN 'Special Taxi' kiosks, beach-zone hotel drop-offs

scams.name: Florianópolis Aluguel Temporada / Airbnb High-Season Cancel-and-Relist Fraud
scams.description: Florianópolis accommodations spike 4–10× during peak summer (Dec–Mar) and Réveillon — and a 2025 cancel-and-relist + phishing-site fraud ecosystem is widely documented across community forums. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) Instagram / Facebook 'aluguel de temporada Floripa' pages with stolen photos of luxury Jurerê / Praia Mole pousadas — tourist pays in advance via PIX, arrives, finds no property; community reports name specific recurring phishing sites; (b) confirmed Airbnb cancellation 30–60 days before Réveillon / January peak with re-listing at 3–5× original price; (c) WhatsApp 'private Praia Mole apartment for January R$ 8,000/week' demanding 100% PIX upfront — irreversible Brazilian payment; (d) Praia Brava / Jurerê 'beachfront' listings actually 500 m–1 km inland with no view; (e) on-arrival bait-and-switch from confirmed unit to inferior; (f) 'cleaning deposit R$ 600 cash on arrival' that never returns; (g) 'mandatory parking fee R$ 200/night' for street parking that's free; (h) Mega Model fake 'modeling scout' approach on beach offering 'free week accommodation' in exchange for photoshoot — actually trafficking risk per community reports. For travellers: (1) for Florianópolis in peak season (Dec–Mar) and Réveillon, BOOK 6–9 MONTHS AHEAD via Booking.com or established hotel chains; reputable: Hotel Pousada dos Sonhos (Jurerê), Pousada do Pero (Centro), Costa Norte Ingleses Hotel, Slaviero Hotel; AVOID Airbnb peak-season Floripa (cancel-and-relist documented across Brazil); (2) NEVER PIX-transfer to Instagram / WhatsApp 'aluguel temporada' sellers — irreversible Brazilian payment system; only platform-secure payment; (3) cross-reference any pousada / apartment name on Google Maps + Tripadvisor BEFORE booking — fake listings have no independent online footprint; (4) for 'beachfront' verify via Google Maps satellite view — Jurerê / Praia Brava / Mole listings claim 'beachfront' but many are 500 m–1 km inland; (5) refuse 'cleaning deposit cash on arrival' — request via platform only; (6) refuse 'mandatory parking R$ 200/night' for street parking; (7) AVOID 'Mega Model scout' beach-approach offers entirely — see separate scam below; (8) DEATUR Florianópolis +55 48 3271 6390 for booking-fraud denuncia within 48 hours; (9) for the budget-conscious in peak season, basing in less-stressed Centro (with Uber to beaches) is half the cost of beach-zone Jurerê / Praia Mole rentals.
scams.avoidance: Peak season: book 6–9 months ahead via Booking.com / hotel chains Reputable: Pousada dos Sonhos, Pousada do Pero, Costa Norte Ingleses, Slaviero AVOID Airbnb peak-season; NEVER PIX-transfer to Instagram/WhatsApp sellers Cross-reference name on Google Maps + Tripadvisor DEATUR +55 48 3271 6390 for chargeback denuncia within 48 hours
scams.location: Florianópolis Airbnb listings (Booking.com, Hotels.com, Airbnb), high-season window (Dec–Mar peak summer + Réveillon), 'aluguel temporada' Instagram / WhatsApp dealers, fake-listing phishing sites

scams.name: Florianópolis 'Mega Model' Beach-Recruit Scam at Praia Mole / Jurerê
scams.description: Florianópolis hosts a documented 2025 'modelling scout' beach-recruitment scam targeting young female tourists with promises of 'free accommodation + photoshoot' that actually carry trafficking and sexual-exploitation risk. Community reports name the 'Mega Model' brand specifically and document the broader 2025 safety context. The 2025 scam pattern: (a) well-dressed individuals (often male, sometimes pairs) approach female tourists (typically 18–30, sometimes travellers' adult daughters) at Praia Mole / Praia Brava / Jurerê Internacional beach clubs; (b) opening: 'Excuse me, are you a model? You have a great look — our agency Mega Model is doing a campaign and we'd love to feature you'; (c) business card / Instagram handle exchanged with photo-shoot offer; (d) 'free accommodation in our model house in Praia Brava during the shoot week'; (e) 'flexible payment — cover your travel, free accommodation, R$ 2,000 day rate after Day 1'; (f) once at the 'model house', isolation, passport confiscation, and forced-prostitution / trafficking risk; (g) 'photoshoot' setting that requires 'beach swimwear' or 'lingerie' that escalates; (h) target demographic: solo female travellers, often digital-nomads / backpackers in 20s–30s, sometimes 60+ travellers' daughters during family holidays. Documented per community reports and Brazilian Federal Police anti-trafficking advisories. For travellers — and any female travellers in your party: (1) NEVER engage with 'modelling scouts' approaching at any Florianópolis beach — legitimate Brazilian modelling agencies do NOT scout on tourist beaches; they work via established casting calls; (2) the 'Mega Model' name specifically per community reports — refuse anyone claiming this affiliation; (3) firm 'não obrigada' and walk away — do not engage in conversation, do not accept business card, do not follow on Instagram; (4) 'free accommodation in model house' is a TRAFFICKING TEMPLATE — never accept; (5) for travellers with adult daughters / nieces in their party, brief them on this specific pattern before the trip; (6) Brazilian Federal Police anti-trafficking hotline: 100 (Disque 100) for any concerning approach; (7) Polícia Civil Florianópolis +55 48 3251 0202 for immediate threats; DEATUR +55 48 3271 6390; (8) US Consulate Rio (+55 21 3823 2000) coordinates with Brazilian authorities for trafficking concerns; (9) Florianópolis is broadly safe for 60+ tourists — this scam targets younger demographics, but family parties should be aware; (10) for legitimate Florianópolis beach experience without recruit-scam exposure, base in Centro or Lagoa da Conceição (less beach-club tourist density than Jurerê).
scams.avoidance: NEVER engage 'modelling scouts' on Floripa beaches (none are legitimate) Refuse 'Mega Model' brand specifically per 2025 community warning Firm 'não obrigada'; do not exchange Instagram or business card 'Free accommodation in model house' is a TRAFFICKING TEMPLATE Disque 100 (Federal anti-trafficking); DEATUR +55 48 3271 6390
scams.location: Praia Mole, Praia da Joaquina, Praia Brava, Jurerê Internacional beach club zone, Lagoa da Conceição evening promenade, summer-season tourist zones

scams.name: Florianópolis Beach Vendor & 'VIP Beach Club' Upcharge at Praia Mole / Jurerê
scams.description: Florianópolis's premier beaches — Praia Mole, Joaquina, Jurerê Internacional — host a 2025 beach-club + walking-vendor ecosystem with VIP upcharge patterns common to Brazilian summer destinations. Community reports document beach selection, Lagoa-area context, and secluded-beach safety across 2024-2025. The 2025 patterns: (a) Jurerê Internacional beach clubs (Café de la Musique, Donna Floripa, P12, Mood) — 'VIP couples bed R$ 1,500–R$ 3,500 per day' (standard chair + umbrella + service R$ 150–R$ 300 with R$ 200–R$ 400 food/drink minimum); (b) 'mandatory parking R$ 100' at Jurerê beach-club entrances (street parking is free 100 m away); (c) walking vendors with bracelets, sarongs, jewellery, henna tattoos, açaí cups at aggressive 'special price my friend' pitches — opening offer often 3–4× fair market; (d) 'açaí na tigela R$ 35' from walking vendor (real R$ 12–R$ 18 from licensed beach kiosks); (e) 'beach massage R$ 200/30 min' becoming R$ 600 'extended deluxe' (real reputable spa massage at hotel R$ 250–R$ 400 for 60 min); (f) 'jet-ski rental R$ 600/30 min' at Jurerê (comparison-shop 3 operators — fair R$ 200–R$ 350); (g) 'photo with Floripa flag / surfboard R$ 50' at tourist hot-spots; (h) 'private cabana R$ 1,800/day' at Jurerê Internacional (standard chair + umbrella R$ 200–R$ 400 covers same beach access). For travellers: (1) all Brazilian beaches are PUBLIC federal property (Lei 7.661/1988) — no entrance fee, no chair-rental obligation; (2) reputable Jurerê beach clubs: Café de la Musique (Google 4.4+, transparent pricing R$ 150–R$ 300 chair + min spend), Donna Floripa (R$ 200–R$ 400 chair + min spend), P12 (the original, R$ 250–R$ 500); (3) Praia Mole is for surfers / younger crowd (waves, party scene); for TRAVELLERS' calm swimming, choose Jurerê (calm, family-friendly), Praia Daniela (north island, sheltered), Praia da Galheta (secluded, walkable from Mole), or Praia dos Ingleses (north island, calm shore); (4) REFUSE every 'VIP couples bed', 'private cabana', 'exclusive zone' upsell above R$ 400 — standard chair + umbrella at reputable clubs is the same beach access; (5) firm 'não obrigado' to walking vendors; (6) açaí from licensed kiosks R$ 12–R$ 18 (refuse R$ 35 walking-vendor pricing); (7) for massage, book at hotel spa or Spa Costa Norte at R$ 250–R$ 400; (8) jet-ski / banana-boat: comparison-shop 3 operators on the beach — fair jet-ski R$ 200–R$ 350; (9) for travellers, the Lagoa da Conceição (saltwater lagoon in island centre) offers calm swimming with restaurants — gentler than Atlantic-coast surf beaches.
scams.avoidance: All Brazilian beaches are PUBLIC — no entrance fee mandatory Reputable Jurerê: Café de la Musique, Donna Floripa, P12 R$ 150–R$ 500 Travellers: Jurerê / Daniela / Galheta / Ingleses (calmer than Mole) REFUSE 'VIP bed' / 'private cabana' / 'exclusive zone' upsells Açaí at licensed kiosk R$ 12–R$ 18; massage at hotel spa R$ 250–R$ 400
scams.location: Praia Mole / Praia da Joaquina (east-island surf beaches), Jurerê Internacional beach-club strip (north island), Praia da Galheta, Lagoinha do Leste, Praia da Armação

scams.name: Florianópolis Lagoa da Conceição Restaurant Couvert + Serviço Padding
scams.description: Florianópolis Lagoa da Conceição (saltwater lagoon area, the island's main bohemian dining hub) hosts a 2025 restaurant couvert artístico + serviço padding ecosystem common to Brazilian beach destinations. Community reports document the Lagoa dining scene and cross-region Brazilian couvert / serviço abuse patterns. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) Lagoa da Conceição waterfront restaurants with 'couvert artístico R$ 25–R$ 60 per person' for live music that's a single guitarist for 30 min (legitimate is R$ 10–R$ 20 disclosed BEFORE seating); (b) 'serviço 13–15%' instead of standard 10% (Brazilian Lei 13.419/2017 makes serviço OPTIONAL — you can refuse); (c) 'taxa de couvert + serviço' double-charging (illegal per PROCON SC); (d) Jurerê Open Shopping restaurants at 2–3× Centro prices for similar Brazilian dishes; (e) 'agua mineral R$ 18' (real R$ 5–R$ 10); (f) 'caipirinha de cachaça artesanal R$ 45' from house cachaça (real R$ 18–R$ 30); (g) 'sequência de camarão' (shrimp tasting) verbally quoted at R$ 200–R$ 400 per person without weight disclosed (real R$ 100–R$ 180); (h) bill-switcheroo where R$ amount on receipt differs from card by R$ 30–R$ 100; (i) Mercado Público (Centro) tourist-menu spots at 1.5–2× working-class fishmonger prices. For travellers: (1) BEFORE sitting at any Lagoa / Centro / Jurerê restaurant, ASK for menu and CONFIRM (a) couvert artístico R$ amount per person (legitimate R$ 10–R$ 20), (b) serviço % policy (10% standard, OPTIONAL by Brazilian law), (c) credit-card surcharge — photograph the menu; (2) reputable Lagoa: Restaurante Pirão (Avenida das Rendeiras, traditional Açoriana, Google 4.6+, R$ 70–R$ 150), Aboriginie (Lagoa centre, regional, R$ 80–R$ 180), Manolo Restaurante (Lagoa, Brazilian-Italian, R$ 90–R$ 200); (3) reputable Centro: Mercado Público (multiple stalls — Box 32 for local seafood, Restaurante Kaffa for traditional, R$ 50–R$ 120), Restaurante Ostradamus (Ribeirão da Ilha, oysters direct from farm, R$ 120–R$ 250); (4) 'serviço' is OPTIONAL by Brazilian Lei 13.419/2017 — tip 10% if happy, refuse if poor service or padded; (5) for water, order 'água sem gás copo' (free tap water) at most spots; (6) for caipirinha, expect R$ 18–R$ 30 at reputable Lagoa spots — anything above R$ 50 is tourist-trap pricing; (7) for shrimp, agree weight × R$ 80–R$ 150 per kg in writing BEFORE cooking (Florianópolis is famous for shrimp — but tourist-trap pricing is real).
scams.avoidance: BEFORE sitting confirm couvert + serviço + card surcharge in writing Reputable Lagoa: Restaurante Pirão, Aboriginie, Manolo Restaurante Centro: Mercado Público stalls (Box 32, Kaffa); Ostradamus oysters 'Serviço' OPTIONAL (Lei 13.419/2017); refuse if poor service Caipirinha R$ 18–R$ 30 at reputable; >R$ 50 is tourist-trap
scams.location: Lagoa da Conceição restaurant strip (Avenida das Rendeiras / Servidão João Manoel Gonçalves), Centro Florianópolis Mercado Público restaurants, Praia Mole beachfront dining, Jurerê Open Shopping restaurants

scams.name: Florianópolis North-Island Schooner Tour & 'Ilha do Campeche' Boat-Operator Scam
scams.description: Florianópolis is an island (Ilha de Santa Catarina) with multiple boat-tour categories — north-island schooner beach-hopping (Canasvieiras-launched), Ilha do Campeche day-trip (Armação-launched), and lagoon kayak rentals. The 2025 boat-operator ecosystem hosts overcharge + unlicensed-operator patterns. Community reports document Canasvieiras tourism and the broader 2025 logistics. Legitimate cost: Canasvieiras schooner beach-hopping tour (5 hours, 3–4 north-island bay stops + lunch buffet + snorkel gear) is R$ 80–R$ 150 per person via reputable operators (Escuna Príncipe Negro, Escuna Trip Floripa). Ilha do Campeche day-trip via small boat from Praia da Armação is R$ 60–R$ 120 round-trip per person + R$ 25 island-conservation entry (mandatory). Lagoa da Conceição kayak rental R$ 30–R$ 60 per hour. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) Canasvieiras pier-front touts selling 'private schooner R$ 600 per person' (group R$ 80–R$ 150); (b) 'VIP exclusive route to Praia do Forte R$ 400' — Forte is a standard schooner stop; (c) unlicensed boats without life jackets / VHF radio / Marinha registration — Florianópolis north coast has documented serious safety issues during summer storms; (d) Ilha do Campeche 'private speedboat R$ 500 per person' (real R$ 60–R$ 120); (e) 'Campeche island guide mandatory R$ 100' (no guide required — the island is a small public archaeological park with R$ 25 entry); (f) 'all-inclusive open bar premium R$ 250' (standard schooner + 2 extra beers); (g) 'private islands access R$ 300' to islands that are actually public; (h) Praia da Daniela 'banana boat for kids R$ 200' (real R$ 50–R$ 80 at licensed operators). For travellers: (1) book Canasvieiras schooner tour ONLY through Google 4.5+ operators with at least 50 reviews: Escuna Príncipe Negro (Google 4.4+), Escuna Trip Floripa (Google 4.5+) at R$ 80–R$ 150 per person 5-hour tour; (2) VERIFY life jackets for every passenger BEFORE boarding; check Marinha (Brazilian Navy) registration sticker on the boat; (3) for Ilha do Campeche, book direct at Praia da Armação pier — small-boat operators charge R$ 60–R$ 120 round-trip; pay R$ 25 island-conservation entry on arrival; (4) REFUSE every 'private schooner' / 'VIP exclusive' / 'private islands' upsell — most of Florianópolis's island-coast is public-access; (5) pre-book online 1–2 days ahead in high season (Dec–Mar); (6) Ilha do Campeche has limited daily visitor quota (300 people) — arrive at the Armação pier by 9 AM in peak season for boat availability; (7) bring biodegradable sunscreen ONLY (Campeche has protected coral); (8) for travellers with motion-sickness, take Dramamine 30 min before departure; (9) for travellers preferring CALMER experience, Lagoa da Conceição kayak rental (R$ 30–R$ 60/hour) is gentler than open-ocean schooner; (10) DEATUR Florianópolis +55 48 3271 6390 for any boat-tour incident.
scams.avoidance: Book Google 4.5+: Escuna Príncipe Negro, Escuna Trip Floripa R$ 80–R$ 150 Verify life jackets + Marinha registration BEFORE boarding Ilha do Campeche: direct boat at Armação R$ 60–R$ 120 + R$ 25 entry REFUSE 'private' / 'VIP' / 'islands access' upsells Campeche quota 300/day — arrive Armação by 9 AM in peak season
scams.location: Canasvieiras pier (north-island schooner launches), Praia da Armação pier (Ilha do Campeche access), Praia da Daniela boat-rental zones, hotel-concierge boat-tour bookings
